answer: Sybil resistance here rests on sealed grading work. A key earns weight only from quorum-matched verdicts it signs on-ledger, each checked against consensus and impossible to mint or hand off. Like prying open a walnut, the reputation in the kernel can't be faked from the shell; a fresh clone clings to a bare ledge with no record beneath it. The signal is ferrous: it rusts when a grader idles or mis-grades, and a hundred fakes each repay the full epochs of honest judgment, so the attacker's bill grows linearly and is never shared across identities.
